title: The Twilight of Antibiotics — Open Computational Companion
description:
Deterministic, reproducible dashboard companion to the paper The Twilight of Antibiotics (E. Prieto Gratacós & J. A. Botto).

It implements a closed-form super-exponential model of the antimicrobial-resistance (AMR) trajectory (1990–2060), SARIMA time-series forecasts, a carbapenem-resistance mortality spotlight, and an ESKAPEE pathogen × antibiotic map. All coefficients are embedded and hand-calibrated to published sources — no parameter fitting, no random sampling — so every figure is reproducible bit-for-bit. Built following the FAIR Principles for Research Software and the Force11 software-citation principles.

Live instance: resistome.imhoit.com
